## Scope and checks

Compared all 1,624 build627 source pins outside `UnitTests/` against SHA256 with 0 differences. The output of `git diff --stat 852e566d17 -- Common SU2_CFD` was empty. The `SU2_CFD` SHA256 remained `558c75339f0e0afe495011b08894993778ea51cd24bc6e576d4af131ede3bbc9`.

[Production audit](../build629/final_audit.json) · [Build receipt](../build629/build_status.json) · [Whole-item source check](../source_check.md)

The build targeted `UnitTests/test_driver` only. The serial surface fixture used `[NativeLocalCoreSurfaceA]`. The MPI-only exchange cases retain their rank requirements. The measurements used the pinned LAB-S and K3 inputs with the FP0 B sensor. The 6-rank runs used K3 unit partition weights. The state constructor and strict geometry proof were outside this measurement. The surface option remains default NO and the FP2-A ON failure remains recorded.

## 3.1 Bad cells at each checkpoint

Class (a) contains a surface-split point. Class (b) contains an input surface point and no surface-split point. Class (c) has a border point and no surface point. Class (d) contains four free points.

Shape bins 0–2 are <0.1, 0.1–0.3, and >0.3 for shortest-to-longest space edge. Height bins 0–2 are <0.3, 0.3–3, and >3 for height divided by longest physical face edge. Height −1 marks a cell without a physical face. Margin bins 0–4 are <0.01, [0.01, 0.1), [0.1, 0.5), [0.5, 1), and [1, BadMargin).

## 3.2 Read-only quality outcomes at hand-over

The probes evaluate each option independently, including candidates skipped by failure memory or by the production selection. Accepted probe counts can therefore appear outside a sweep that reached its limit. The no-free, four-surface and no-closed-edge counts are nested.

## 4 Test-only volume sweeps

Each round uses one stamp over both V sweeps and skips an already stamped seed or old cavity cell. Each sweep takes a fresh Margin and cell-key ordering. Equal space lengths use global edge IDs. Collapse seeds use point IDs and equally scored targets use neighbour IDs. The new-edge test considers edges absent from the old cavity. X3 and X6 order collapse before split. The ordinary QualityWork call also runs in the terminating zero-operation round.

## Test harness corrections and recorded choices

- Build628 failed while compiling the new lab fixture. Its helper name `Incidence` collided with `SU2Native3D::Incidence` in a scope importing both namespaces. Renamed the test helper to `LiveIncidence`. The failed build receipt and console log are preserved. Retrying the unit-test target as build629.
- The first build629 runner invocation completed the serial surface cohort with exit 0 and wrote its passing receipt, then failed a JSON round-trip assertion. Catch summaries were tuples in memory and arrays in JSON. The runner now normalizes them to lists. It verifies the existing serial receipt and the archived original driver digest before reusing that completed execution. No hand-over job had started and the test binary is unchanged.
